title: Fair Dinkum
blurb: Thongs, servos, snags and footy: who here is the most Aussie?

prompts: Most likely to wear thongs to a wedding
Most likely to get swooped by a magpie and take it personally
Most likely to walk into Bunnings for one thing and leave with a full trolley
Most likely to eat a servo pie for breakfast
Most likely to stay at the beach until they're the colour of a cooked prawn
Most likely to call everyone "mate", including their boss
Most likely to defend Vegemite to every overseas visitor they meet
Most likely to keep an esky in their car at all times
Most likely to start a heated debate about which state makes the best pie
Most likely to wear Ugg boots to the shops and not think twice
Most likely to cheer for the underdog in every single footy final
Most likely to teach a tourist how to do a Tim Tam Slam
Most likely to let a huntsman live in the corner and give it a name
Most likely to drive four hours for a weekend away and call it "just down the road"
Most likely to bring a pav to every barbie
Most likely to be first in line at the Bunnings sausage sizzle
Most likely to say "she'll be right" while things go very wrong
Most likely to appoint themselves boss of the barbie at every gathering
Most likely to argue whether it's a potato cake or a potato scallop
Most likely to chuck a sickie for the cricket
Most likely to own a ute they absolutely don't need
Most likely to crouch on Rottnest for twenty minutes to get the perfect quokka selfie
Most likely to know the best fish and chip shop in every beach town
Most likely to wear a footy jumper to a formal event
Most likely to hit snooze on their own 5am surf plan
Most likely to name their dog after a footy player
Most likely to turn "a quick drink at the pub" into the whole arvo
Most likely to have a can of insect repellent in every bag they own
Most likely to complain about the heat in summer and the "freezing" 15 degrees in winter
Most likely to tell the story of their Nullarbor drive like it was an epic quest
Most likely to have prawns and pav for Christmas lunch at the beach
Most likely to go camping and forget the tent pegs
Most likely to build a backyard pool they swim in twice a year
Most likely to watch the Melbourne Cup with no idea which horse is which
Most likely to take the Hottest 100 more seriously than an election
Most likely to have a stubby holder from every pub they've ever visited
Most likely to turn up to a kids' footy match with a folding chair and a thermos
Most likely to get a tan line in the exact shape of their watch
Most likely to give directions using the pub, the servo and "that big gum tree"
Most likely to bring their own tomato sauce to a restaurant
Most likely to refer to a stranger as "legend" within ten seconds of meeting
Most likely to do a lap of the bottle-o for a mate's birthday and come back with a slab and a card
Most likely to know which roundabout in town has the best bakery next to it
Most likely to call a dressing gown a "housecoat" and fight anyone who disagrees
Most likely to watch the Boxing Day Test with the radio on and the telly muted
Most likely to get lost on a bush walk that had a sign saying "easy 20 minutes"
Most likely to put beetroot on a burger and defend it with their life
Most likely to think forty degrees is "a bit warm today"
Most likely to pronounce every town name wrong in front of a local
